TreeNote.title: TreeNote
TreeNote.description: A Google Keep-style sticky note or checklist pinned onto the Christmas tree widget and synced per user.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase Auth UID of the note owner.

title.description: Note title displayed on cards and Christmas tree ornaments (0..120 chars).

colorKey.description: Festive sticky note color palette token.

pinnedToTree.description: Whether this note is pinned onto the Christmas tree home screen widget.

checklistMode.description: Whether this note renders as an interactive checklist.

checklistItems.description: Up to 30 checklist items (each map with itemId, text, checked).

treeTier.description: Preferred Christmas tree tier (0 = auto, 1..4 = specific tier).

/users/{userId}/notes/{noteId}.description: User-scoped Christmas tree sticky notes and checklists.
